name: @blopus-ai/openclaw-plugin
description: Give your agent the open web: search, read full pages, and pull images — from an index Blopus crawls itself, not a reseller of another engine's results. blopus_search (freshness windows, domain filters, inline full text, hero images) + blopus_fetch (complete page text, 50 URLs per call) + image search (beta). Get an API key at blopus.ai
author: Blopus

scripts.build: tsc index.ts --outDir dist --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck
